name: SofaScore
tagline: Live scores and sports statistics API (no public self-serve developer access)
description: SofaScore is a commercial sports data platform covering football, basketball, tennis, and many other sports with live scores, statistics, fixtures, standings, and player data. There is no public self-serve developer API with documented signup, pricing, or official docs for third-party apps. Community reverse-engineered endpoints exist under api.sofascore.com but are unofficial, unsupported, and subject to blocking or terms-of-service restrictions. Partner or enterprise data access may exist via commercial sales channels only.

auth.details: No public developer authentication or self-serve API keys. Unofficial community-documented endpoints typically require no API key but are not authorized for third-party production use. Enterprise/partner access, if available, is via private commercial sales only.

pricing.paid_plans: No public pricing. Partner or enterprise data access, if offered, is sales-negotiated only.

use_cases: get live football match scores and status
fetch upcoming fixtures for a tournament
retrieve team standings and league tables
look up player statistics for a match
get tennis or basketball event schedules
